common.passwordResetPolicy: Password resets are handled by the CVO administrator for security reasons. Contact the office at {{email}} or {{phone}} to request a new password.

login.heading: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the account issued by the {{office}}.
login.resetIntro: Enter your account email and we'll send you a 6-digit reset code.
login.resetSent: If that email address is in our records, a 6-digit reset code has been sent.

errors.identifier: Enter your username or email address.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter the email address registered to your account. If it matches our records, we'll send a 6-digit verification code.
forgotPassword.emailHint: Use the Gmail or email address on your CVO account.
forgotPassword.noEmailNote: For security, we don't confirm whether an address is registered. Check your inbox and spam folder after sending.

session.expired: Your session expired — please sign in again.
session.inactivity: You were signed out due to inactivity.

presence.label: Presence
presence.onlineAria: Online — signed in and active now
presence.deactivatedAria: Deactivated — this account cannot sign in
presence.onlineCountHint: Signed in within the last few minutes. Not affected by the presence filter.

resetPassword.verifyIntro: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Enter it below to continue.
resetPassword.codeSent: If that email address is in our records, a 6-digit code has been sent. It may take a minute to arrive.
resetPassword.codeExpired: This code has expired. Request a new one.
resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.intro: Set a new password for {{email}}. You'll sign in with it right after.
resetPassword.verifiedIntro: Your code is verified. Set a new password for {{email}}.
resetPassword.success: Your password has been reset. Redirecting you to sign in…
resetPassword.passwordHint: At least 8 characters with upper and lower case, a number and a symbol.

errors.passwordWeak: Use at least 8 characters with upper and lower case, a number and a symbol.

resetPassword.invalidLinkTitle: This reset link can't be used
resetPassword.invalidLinkBody: The link is missing its email or token, or it has expired. Request a new verification code.
